title: Python Engineering for Backend & AI Systems
description: Senior-level Python for AI Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering interviews: the object model, concurrency, idioms, design patterns, machine coding, CPython internals, async FastAPI services, testing and code quality, and production AI applications.
verticalDescription: Python mastery for AI Engineering and FDE roles: language internals, design, async services, and production AI applications.

modules.title: Python Object Model, Concurrency & Idioms
modules.description: Inheritance and the MRO, ABCs and Protocols, the data model, threads, processes and the GIL, executors, synchronization, async foundations, and idiomatic Python.

lessons.title: Inheritance, MRO and Polymorphism
lessons.description: How Python resolves attributes through the C3 MRO, cooperative super(), and polymorphism without interfaces.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: OOP-3: Inheritance, MRO and Polymorphism

lessons.title: ABCs, Protocols and Mixins
lessons.description: Nominal versus structural typing, abc.ABC, typing.Protocol, and when mixins help or hurt.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: OOP-4: ABCs, Protocols and Mixins

lessons.title: Magic Methods and the Python Data Model
lessons.description: Dunder methods, equality and hashing, containers, context managers, and operator overloading.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: OOP-5: Magic Methods and the Python Data Model

lessons.title: OOP Lab: Modelling a Real Domain
lessons.description: Applying encapsulation, inheritance, composition and the data model to a complete domain model.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: OOP Lab Session

lessons.title: Processes, Threads and the GIL
lessons.description: What the GIL protects, CPU-bound versus I/O-bound work, threading versus multiprocessing, and free-threaded CPython.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Concurrency-1: Processes, Threads and the GIL

lessons.title: Executors and Futures
lessons.description: concurrent.futures, thread and process pools, futures, exception propagation, and cancellation.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Concurrency-2: Executors and Futures

lessons.title: Synchronization and an Introduction to Async
lessons.description: Race conditions, locks, conditions, semaphores, queues, deadlock, and the first step into asyncio.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Concurrency-3: Synchronization and Async Intro

lessons.title: Decorators, Iterators and Generators
lessons.description: Closures and decorators, the iterator protocol, generators, yield from, and lazy pipelines.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Pythonic-1: Decorators, Iterators and Generators

lessons.title: Collections, Dataclasses, Type Hints and Exceptions
lessons.description: The collections module, dataclasses, type hints that pay for themselves, and exception design.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Pythonic-2: Collections, Dataclasses, Type Hints and Exceptions

modules.title: SOLID & Design Patterns in Python
modules.description: SOLID for extensible systems with AI integrations, creational, structural and behavioural patterns written the Pythonic way, and UML.

lessons.title: SOLID Principles for Extensible Systems with AI Integrations
lessons.description: SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP and DIP applied to Python services that call models and external providers.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: SOLID Principles for Extensible Systems with AI integrations

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Introduction and Singleton
lessons.description: Why patterns exist, the Singleton in Python, module-level state, thread safety, and testability costs.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Introduction and Singleton

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Builder
lessons.description: Step-wise construction, validation at build time, fluent interfaces, and when keyword arguments are enough.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Builder

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Prototype and Registry
lessons.description: Cloning with copy and deepcopy, prototype registries, and plugin registration.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Prototype and Registry

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Factory for Service Abstraction
lessons.description: Simple factory, factory method and abstract factory for swapping providers behind one interface.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Leveraging Factory Pattern for Service Abstraction.

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Adapter and Facade
lessons.description: Wrapping third-party SDKs behind your own interface and simplifying subsystems.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Adapter and Facade

lessons.title: Design Patterns: Decorator and Flyweight
lessons.description: Structural decoration versus Python's @decorator, composing behaviour, and sharing state to save memory.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Decorator and Flyweight

lessons.title: Behavioural Design Patterns
lessons.description: Strategy, Observer, Command, State and Chain of Responsibility in idiomatic Python.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Design Patterns: Behavioural Design Patterns

lessons.title: UML Diagrams for Design Interviews
lessons.description: Class and sequence diagrams, relationships and multiplicity, and communicating a design quickly.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: UML Diagrams

modules.title: Machine Coding in Python
modules.description: Approaching LLD interviews, then designing and coding TicTacToe, Parking Lot, BookMyShow and Splitwise end to end with SQLAlchemy-backed layers.

lessons.title: How to Approach Design Problems
lessons.description: Clarifying requirements, finding entities, drawing the class diagram, and pacing a machine-coding round.
lessons.sourceLesson: Backend LLD: Machine Coding - 1/2: How to approach design problems

lessons.title: Code TicTacToe 1: Design and Core Game Loop

lessons.title: Code TicTacToe 2: Winning Strategies, Bots and Undo

lessons.title: Design Parking Lot

lessons.title: Code Parking Lot 1: Layers, Models and Ticket Issuance

lessons.title: Code Parking Lot 2: Payments, Fees and Concurrency

lessons.title: Design BookMyShow
lessons.description: Requirements, entities, seat and show modelling, and the class diagram for a ticket-booking system.

lessons.title: Code BookMyShow 1: SQLAlchemy Models and Relationships

lessons.title: Code BookMyShow 2: Booking, Transactions and Race Conditions

lessons.title: Code Splitwise 2: Settle-Up Strategies

modules.title: CPython Internals & Performance
modules.description: The object model and memory, scopes and descriptors, metaclasses, bytecode and the GIL, profiling, and the import system.

lessons.title: The CPython Object Model and Memory Management
lessons.description: PyObject, identity and mutability, reference counting, the cyclic GC, interning, and __slots__.

lessons.title: Scopes, Closures and Descriptors
lessons.description: LEGB, closures and cell variables, the descriptor protocol, properties, and attribute lookup order.

lessons.title: Metaclasses and Class Creation
lessons.description: type, __init_subclass__, __set_name__, class decorators, and when a metaclass is justified.

lessons.title: Bytecode, the Evaluation Loop and the GIL
lessons.description: dis, frames, the specializing interpreter, GIL switching, free-threaded CPython and subinterpreters.

lessons.title: Profiling and Performance Engineering
lessons.description: Measuring before optimizing: timeit, cProfile, py-spy, tracemalloc, complexity of built-ins, and vectorization.

lessons.title: The Import System, Packages and Runtime Environments
lessons.description: How import works, packages and namespaces, circular imports, entry points, and virtual environments.

modules.title: Async Python & FastAPI Services
modules.description: asyncio in depth, async patterns and backpressure, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, dependency injection, async persistence, security, and production operation.

lessons.title: asyncio in Depth
lessons.description: The event loop, coroutines, tasks, cancellation, TaskGroup, timeouts, and structured concurrency.

lessons.title: Async Patterns, Backpressure and Blocking Calls
lessons.description: Semaphores and queues, producer-consumer, async HTTP clients, run_in_executor, and contextvars.

lessons.title: FastAPI Fundamentals
lessons.description: Path operations, request and response models, validation, status codes, errors, and OpenAPI.

lessons.title: Pydantic v2 in Depth
lessons.description: Models, field and model validators, serialization, discriminated unions, settings, and performance.

lessons.title: Dependency Injection and Service Architecture in FastAPI
lessons.description: Depends, lifespan, layered architecture, repositories and services, configuration, and testable wiring.

lessons.title: Async Persistence with SQLAlchemy 2.0 and Alembic
lessons.description: Engines and sessions, async sessions, unit of work, transactions, N+1 queries, and migrations.

lessons.title: Authentication and Security for FastAPI Services
lessons.description: OAuth2 and JWT, password hashing, sessions versus tokens, CORS, rate limiting, and secrets.

lessons.title: Running FastAPI in Production
lessons.description: Middleware, error handling, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, background work, workers, and containers.

modules.title: Testing, Code Quality & Interview Readiness
modules.description: pytest and fixtures, mocking and async tests, advanced typing, tooling and project layout, resilient error handling, and a senior Python interview playbook.

lessons.title: pytest Fundamentals and Fixtures
lessons.description: Test discovery, assertions, fixtures and scopes, parametrization, markers, and conftest design.

lessons.title: Mocking, Test Doubles and Async Tests
lessons.description: unittest.mock, patching where it is looked up, fakes versus mocks, testing async code and HTTP clients.

lessons.title: Advanced Typing and Static Analysis
lessons.description: Generics, TypeVar, ParamSpec, Protocol, overloads, TypedDict, and strict mypy or pyright.

lessons.title: Tooling, Packaging and Project Layout
lessons.description: pyproject.toml, uv and dependency locking, ruff, pre-commit, src layout, and CI quality gates.

lessons.title: Error Handling, Logging and Resilience
lessons.description: Exception hierarchies, exception groups, structured logging, retries with backoff, timeouts, and idempotency.

lessons.title: The Senior Python Interview Playbook
lessons.description: Idioms interviewers look for, live-coding discipline, common traps, and how to talk about trade-offs.

modules.title: Python for Production AI Applications
modules.description: LLM clients, structured output with Pydantic, retrieval pipelines, agents and tool use, and serving AI features from FastAPI.

lessons.title: Building Robust LLM API Clients
lessons.description: Async clients, streaming, timeouts, retries, rate limits, token budgets and cost tracking.

lessons.title: Structured Output and Tool Calling with Pydantic
lessons.description: JSON Schema from models, tool definitions, validating and repairing model output, and typed results.

lessons.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipelines in Python
lessons.description: Ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, prompt assembly, and evaluation.

lessons.title: Agents, Tool Use and Orchestration
lessons.description: The agent loop, tool registries, state and memory, graph orchestration, guardrails, and failure modes.

lessons.title: Serving AI Features from FastAPI
lessons.description: Streaming responses, background jobs, caching, observability, evaluation in CI, and cost controls.
